question: Samudragupta’s achievements are recorded in a long inscription called Prashasti by his court poet, _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harisena__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Harisena composed the Allahabad Pillar Inscription, also known as the Prashasti, which glorifies the achievements of Samudragupta.
 
• The Prashasti is a prime source of information about Samudragupta's military conquests and governance.
 
• It is written in classical Sanskrit, using the Nagari script, and is an example of high literary merit as well as historical significance.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Harisena
 Author of the Allahabad Pillar Inscription praising Samudragupta.
 
 

 2) Rudrasena
 There were several rulers with this name, but none associated directly with Samudragupta's court.
 
 

 3) Kalhan
 Author of the Rajatarangini, a historical chronicle of the north-western Indian subcontinent, particularly Kashmir.
 
 

 4) Kalidasa
 A classical Sanskrit author, widely regarded as the greatest poet and dramatist in the Sanskrit language, but not related to Samudragupta's court.
